title: Influence of oral health behaviour and motor maturity on the caries experience of preschool children in group prophylaxis - a pilot study
summary:
The aim of the study is to determine the caries experience of the children and to show a possible connection to the oral health behaviour of the parents on the one hand and to the motor maturity of the child on the other. 
The following questions were asked in detail:
2. is there a correlation between the motor maturity of preschool children and their dmft/DMFT score?
3. is there a correlation between the oral health behaviour of the parents and the dmft/DMFT of the child?

interventions.name: Pre-school children (aged 5 to 7) who take part in the group prophylaxis programme are tested for their dental status (dmft/DMFT value). In addition, motor maturity and oral health behaviour are assessed using questionnaires.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Children aged 5.0 to 7.11 years who take part in the group prophylaxis programme at daycare centres in Hesse.
-with a signed declaration of consent from the parents or legal guardians (questionnaire).
Exclusion criteria:
Children without returned questionnaires/surveys of parents or guardians.
- Children whose dmft value cannot be collected.
